Our story

It started with one agent.

We did the hard part by hand, over and over, until we could do it in software. That method is the company.

Otian is drawn from the Latin otium, the ease that comes when someone you trust is handling your affairs for you.

How we got here

We set up agents by hand, one at a time.

Jett set up an AI agent for Jack. Jack had already bought a Mac mini and downloaded OpenClaw, which runs on your own computer and takes skills you add. Getting it running meant a terminal, and that was the hard part.

So we started doing it for other people. By hand, one at a time, over and over, until we knew exactly where the friction lived. We learned which steps tripped people up, which ones needed an hour of explaining, and which ones nobody should ever have to see.

Archie is what we learned. Same principles, your own computer and an agent that is yours, without the terminal. It’s inspired by OpenClaw, and none of it is built on OpenClaw’s code.

Now we’re doing the same thing again with add-ons, doing the hard part by hand until we can do it in software. If Archie can’t do it yet, tell us: we scope it and quote a price before we build the add-on, and it can then join the shelf for everyone after you.

We met as coworkers at MARA Holdings Inc., Jett in Florida and Jack in Texas. One of us sees where AI can help people; the other builds it. When you work with Otian AI, you work with us: the same two people, start to finish.

The first message

Jack asked for help on LinkedIn, and Jett said yes.

Before there was a company, there was a LinkedIn message. Jack (trying to stand up an AI assistant on a Mac mini he couldn’t quite get working) asked an old coworker for a hand. Here’s that conversation, on Jett’s screen.

Jack Raney 1st · former coworker at MARA
April 23
Jack Raney11:20 AM
Yo Jett!! Hope all is well man and that you are excited for summer. Random question for you, do you have any experience with AI agents? Let me kno!!
Jett Nguyen11:32 AM
Hey Jack! Hope you’re doing good and everything is well at MARA! I use AI agents a lot in my personal projects and I find it super helpful. I usually use Claude Code (which just started out at MARA right before my internship ended) and GitHub Copilot, and I’m always finding new ways to get the most out of it. Since my internship, I’ve shifted my focus towards UI/UX because I felt that’s where my niche lies and AI agents can really use the human perspective when it comes to software development.
Jack Raney11:44 AM
Super sick! I have been researching and learning about agents on the side and looking to build out my own as my own personal assistant. I bought a Mac mini and downloaded open claw but have been having trouble getting it working since I am not too technically savvy. Kinda a random ask but would you have time to help me learn how to build mine? More than happy to kick you some money to help guide me thru it if you are interested. Let me know dawg
Jett Nguyen1:03 PM
Yeah for sure man! I haven’t had any experience in open claw but I’d be happy to try and help through the setup process and maybe get the experience to set my own up haha. When would you be down to set it up?

That was the whole beginning: one former coworker asking another for a hand. Jett had never touched OpenClaw either; they figured it out together, then kept figuring it out for other people, until the method became Otian AI.

How we work

Three things we hold to with every client.

Our mission: to give ordinary people an AI agent they actually own, one that takes the friction out of daily life.

We talk to you in plain language

You’ll never get an email full of acronyms or jargon. If something technical comes up, we translate it.

We only set up what you’ve approved

Nothing gets connected or configured without your explicit sign-off. We walk through every access request with you before making any changes.

We stay with you after launch

Questions about what we set up with you are answered free, with no time limit. If you want something new, we scope it and price it with you first.

Book a free call about what you would hand off.

Book Your Free Call

Tell us what you’d want an agent to handle, and we’ll tell you what it would take.

Don’t rent your agent. Own it.
Yours to shape & yours to keep. Never ours.
